description: Executable DeFi Swap & Cross-Chain Bridge Action Calldata Builder ($0.05 USDC). Queries LI.FI and ParaSwap aggregators to compute the best DEX/Bridge route and returns ready-to-sign EVM transaction calldata (to, data, value, gasLimit) on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon, and Optimism.

amount.description: Amount of from_token to swap (human-readable e.g. '10' or atomic units)

from_token.description: Source token symbol (e.g., 'USDC', 'ETH', 'AERO') or 0x contract address

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2/v1 Base64 or JSON EIP-3009 USDC payment signature to unlock the full unmasked dataset directly via MCP

to_chain.description: Destination blockchain network (default: same as from_chain)

wallet.description: Optional 0x sender wallet address for transaction simulation

x_api_key.description: Optional ak_live_... 30-day Prepaid API Pass key to unlock the full unmasked dataset

name: defi_swap_quote
